title: dot-agents project manifest
description: Repo-local schema for .agentsrc.json. Accepts both v1 and v2 of the manifest surface. v1 omits the v2 additive fields (repo_id, extends, packages, features, and the Source.id/cache_ttl/auth + http/oci source types). All v2 fields are optional so a v1 file continues to validate against this schema.

version.description: Schema version. 1 = legacy surface; 2 = surface that activates the v2 additive fields.

graph_home.description: Path to KG_HOME. Overrides KG_HOME env var.

enabled.description: Whether bridge queries are active for this project

allowed_intents.description: If non-empty, restricts bridge to this intent set

verifier_profiles.description: Named verifier profiles referenced by app_type_verifier_map and workflow fanout

reviewer_profiles.description: Named reviewer profiles keyed by review lens (architecture-standards, acceptance-invariants, adversarial); symmetric to verifier_profiles. prompt_files compose base-first into the reviewer bundle.

app_type_verifier_map.description: Maps app_type strings to ordered verifier profile ids for fanout bundle resolution

refresh.description: Latest da install/refresh metadata recorded on the project.

examples: Refreshed dot-agents project from ~/.agents/ into project directories.

repo_id.description: v2: canonical repository identity (e.g. 'github.com/acme/manager-ui'). Protected: imported layers cannot override it.

extends.description: v2: ordered list of config layer references. Each entry is either a string 'source-id:layer-path[@version]' or an object with optional flag.

packages.description: v2: ordered list of executable package references 'source-id:artifact-path@version-spec'.

features.description: v2: feature-flag overrides keyed by feature name.

execution_profile.description: config-v2 §15 execution-profile layer (kind=layer). Routes a task's workflow execution shape — unit relevance + topology + lenses — by app_type. Scope-mergeable; unlisted units default to 'situational' (default_class) so nothing is silently dropped. See skill-relevance-filter design.

by_app_type.description: Per-app_type execution shape, keyed by app_type string (e.g. 'go-cli', 'ideation').

default_class.description: Relevance class for any unit not explicitly listed. Defaults to 'situational' — unlisted units are never silently dropped.

pr_source.description: pr-event-source D4: config-driven pull-request event producer. Configures the generic internal/events producer engine (fetch + field map per platform) so PR state becomes event.pr.* events with no per-platform Go. 'gh' is the zero-config default; resolves through the config-v2 scope layers so an org layer can set the default. additionalProperties open for forward-compatible producer options.

producer.description: Named producer: 'gh' (default), 'exec', 'http', or a registered code producer.

type.description: v2: http and oci added per config-distribution-model §4. v1 files declaring only local/git remain valid.

id.description: v2: stable local identifier used in extends/packages refs.

cache_ttl.description: v2: tier-1 cache TTL duration (e.g. '4h'). Ignored for oci sources.

auth.description: v2: opaque auth block. Schema owned by external-agent-sources spec; treated as pass-through here. Well-known pass-through keys read by the config layer: 'signing' (unsigned|optional|required — package signing-posture stub, config-distribution-model §12) and 'token' (bearer token for http package pulls).

signing.description: v2 (p5 stub): package signing posture. 'required' fails resolution for an unverifiable artifact once cosign/sigstore verification lands; defaults to 'unsigned'.

layerRef.description: v2: extends entry. Either a plain reference string 'source-id:layer-path[@version]' or an object with optional flag.

packageRef.description: v2: packages entry. Reference string 'source-id:artifact-path@version-spec' or object form.

prFetchBlock.description: pr-event-source D4: one named fetch block of a pr_source config. exec sets 'argv'; http sets 'url'/'method'/'headers'. 'each' selects the item list and 'map' projects each item onto canonical PR fields (canonical-field -> jsonpath).

argv.description: exec: command and arguments. '{number}' is substituted per PR in the comments block.

each.description: JSONPath to the list of items in the fetched document (e.g. '.' for the top-level array, '.comments').

map.description: Canonical field -> JSONPath (relative to an item). The reserved 'rollup' field should point at the platform's raw check array (gh: '.statusCheckRollup'); the producer derives the canonical Rollup.State (GREEN|FAILING|PENDING) from it on each cycle.

appTypeProfile.description: The three execution facets for one app_type: unit relevance, topology, and lenses. Each facet is independently scope-overridable.

relevance.description: Facet 1 (the noise filter): per-stage core/situational/noise unit classification, keyed by stage name (e.g. 'orchestrate', 'verify', 'review').

relevanceClasses.description: Partitions the units relevant to one app_type × stage into reversible-view classes. Unlisted units default to default_class.

topology.description: Facet 2: the executor:verifier:reviewer fan-out shape. Supersedes the flat app_type_verifier_map (verifier_sequence moves here).

executors.description: Number of parallel executor workers for the task.

verifiers_per_executor.description: Verifier fan-out per executor (n exec → verifiers_per_executor·n verifiers).

reviewers.description: Reviewer fan-out: a keyword ('per_verifier', 'per_executor') or a stringified integer count.

verifier_sequence.description: Ordered verifier-profile ids for this app_type, superseding app_type_verifier_map.

lenses.description: Facet 3: the review-lens config folded in from lens-evidence-policy.
